heroHeadline: Tshisekedi Launches National Dialogue, Excludes M23, as DRC Suspends Universities in Rebel-Held Kivus
heroSubtitle: President Tshisekedi opened a three-month national dialogue on Aug 28 that explicitly rules out AFC/M23 participation, days after Kinshasa suspended academic activity at 11 universities in M23-held Goma and Bukavu — moves that run on a separate track from the Doha-mediated roadmap DRC and M23 agreed Aug 22. The ICJ set a 2027-2028 filing timetable for DRC's case against Rwanda, and DRC launched an Ebola vaccination campaign for frontline workers in Kisangani as the outbreak passed 5,794 confirmed cases.
